article.headline: Beyond Spreadsheets: The Logic of the Weddings.io Intelligence Layer
article.description: The South Asian wedding industry runs on spreadsheets, group chats, and guesswork. We replaced all of it with an intelligence layer built on logistics engineering, real-time verification, and computational geometry. Here is the technical logic behind every tool.
